# Glenn Velasco, NYC Real Estate Agent at Compass

> Glenn Velasco is a Licensed Real Estate Salesperson with Compass in New York City (NY license 10401373366). He helps buyers, sellers, renters and international investors in Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens, and works in English, Spanish, Italian and French. Glenn is part of the M Team at Compass, a team with nearly 20 years in New York City.

- Office: Compass, 110 5th Ave, 7th Floor, New York, NY 10003
- Phone: 929-392-3707
- Email: glenn.velasco@compass.com
- Specialties: international buyers, international investors, first-time home buyers, NYC condos, co-ops and rentals
